# DualProfile

> DualProfile is a Chrome extension for WhatsApp Web that helps people separate work and personal life on one WhatsApp account by automatically scheduling profile photo changes.

Website: https://vivaup.org/
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/dualprofile/mdlhdncmaeepcejdbpnjpjlmagmmpkpc

## What DualProfile does

- **Scheduled Photos:** Automatically changes your WhatsApp profile photo according to a schedule you choose. For example, show a professional photo during work hours and a personal photo outside work. Each change requires your confirmation.
- **Photo History & Revert:** Restore a recently used profile photo.
- **Per-Contact Photos:** An experimental feature that lets you assign a different photo to a specific contact. Both people must have DualProfile installed. Available on WhatsApp Web only.
- **Export & Import:** Back up and restore contact assignments.
- **Multi-Device Sync:** Sync supported preferences across devices.

## Privacy

- DualProfile does not access or store WhatsApp chat content.
- Scheduled Photos works on your own WhatsApp account. Other people do not need to install DualProfile.
- Per-Contact Photos requires both people to have DualProfile installed.

## Compatibility

- Chrome and Edge browsers.
- WhatsApp Web.
- Per-Contact Photos is experimental and does not support group chats or the WhatsApp mobile app.

## Help and documentation

- Support: https://vivaup.org/support
- Privacy Policy: https://vivaup.org/privacy
- Per-Contact Photos: https://vivaup.org/per-contact
